summary: @ornikar/renovate-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header) with string-array rotation and hex-obfuscated identifiers (_0x..., WV8StW rotator); its body is opaque. The package's README states it is a deprecated Renovate JSON-config superseded by ornikar/renovate-presets, and package.json otherwise contains only static Renovate configuration metadata — there is no functional reason for a config-only package to fetch an alternate language runtime and execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at install time. Installing the package causes the obfuscated Bun-executed payload to run on the installer's host on npm install, before any code review of the package contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
